definitions.name: Needful Taste
definitions.description: You have a much lower chance to get food poisoning.
definitions.implementation: Anything consumed (food, potions) that give the player poison, hunger or other debuffs has a 50% chance not to do so.
definitions.acceptance:
Test with common food items from Vanilla and mods to verify that 
a) food items like rotten flesh, spider eyes, raw chicken and so on have a 50% change not to give the debuff, 
b) that items like combined potions always give the positive effect but only 50% of the time the negative effect (for each negative effect).
c) Other effects (like spells) that apply negative effects are not altered.
